title: Bath Hotel Deals: Spa Hotels & Georgian Townhouses
description: Compare Bath hotel prices on every big booking site. Stay near the Roman Baths, Royal Crescent and Thermae Bath Spa, with tips for spa breaks and busy dates.
intro: Honey-stone terraces, the Roman Baths and rooftop thermal pools: compare Bath hotel prices for your dates on every site.

sections.html: Bath is the UK’s original spa town. Thermae Bath Spa uses the city’s natural thermal water, and several hotels have their own spas too. Compare packages that include treatments or spa access against room-only rates plus a separate spa booking. See spa breaks for more ideas.

faqs.q: Do I need a car for a weekend in Bath?
faqs.a: Not really. The centre is compact and walkable, and Bath Spa station has direct trains from London. Central parking is limited, so check what your hotel offers if you drive.
